name: Question 14
problem:
Suppose we wish to approximate the solution to an initial value problem using the following numerical method:

$$
\begin{aligned}Δy & =\operatorname{ln}⁡(x+y)\cdot Δx \\ {y}_{\text{new}} & =y+Δy\end{aligned}
$$

If the exact solution is ${y}_{\text{exact}}(x)={x}^{2}+1,$ find an expression for the local truncation error for the step from $x$ to ${x}_{\text{new}}=x+Δx.$

Question 14
?

Suppose we wish to approximate the solution to an initial value problem using the following numerical method: Δy=ln⁡(x+y)⋅Δxynew=y+Δy If the exact solution is yexact(x)=x2+1, find an expression for the local truncation error for the step from x to xnew=x+Δx.

a
(x−ln⁡(x2+x+1))⋅Δx+(Δx)2
b
(2x−ln⁡(x2+x+1))⋅Δx+2(Δx)2
c
(2x−ln⁡(x2+1))⋅Δx+(Δx)2
d
(2x−ln⁡(x2+x+1))⋅Δx+(Δx)2
e
(2x−ln⁡(x+x2))⋅Δx+(Δx)2
Submit
